Gnetum_africanum.description: A vine native to West and Central African rainforests. Used as a wild vegetable.

Khaya_anthotheca.description: Large rainforest tree native to tropical Africa, valued for timber.

Cassava.description: Staple root crop widely grown across Africa.

diseases.name: Cassava Mosaic Disease
diseases.description: Viral disease causing yellow mosaic patterns, leaf distortion and reduced yield.
diseases.organic_treatment: Remove heavily infected plants and use disease-free planting material.
diseases.chemical_treatment: No direct chemical cure. Control whiteflies using approved insecticides where necessary.
diseases.prevention_tips: Plant resistant varieties and regularly inspect fields.

Maize.description: Major cereal crop grown throughout Africa.

diseases.name: Fall Armyworm Infestation
diseases.description: Larvae feed on leaves and whorls causing severe damage.
diseases.organic_treatment: Handpick larvae where practical and encourage natural predators.
diseases.chemical_treatment: Apply approved fall armyworm insecticides according to local recommendations.
diseases.prevention_tips: Scout fields early and use integrated pest management.

diseases.name: Maize Streak Disease
diseases.description: Viral disease causing yellow streaks along leaves.
diseases.organic_treatment: Remove infected plants and control leafhopper vectors.
diseases.chemical_treatment: Use vector control where economically justified.
diseases.prevention_tips: Use resistant varieties and maintain field hygiene.

Tomato.description: Popular vegetable crop grown commercially and domestically.

diseases.name: Early Blight
diseases.description: Fungal disease causing dark concentric spots on leaves.
diseases.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve air circulation.
diseases.prevention_tips: Rotate crops and avoid overhead irrigation.

diseases.name: Late Blight
diseases.description: Aggressive disease affecting leaves, stems and fruits.
diseases.prevention_tips: Monitor humid weather and avoid excessive moisture.

Beans.description: Important protein crop widely grown in Africa.

diseases.name: Bean Rust
diseases.description: Fungal disease producing rust-coloured pustules on leaves.
diseases.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve airflow.
diseases.chemical_treatment: Apply approved fungicides if disease pressure is severe.
diseases.prevention_tips: Use resistant varieties and avoid overcrowding.

diseases.name: Angular Leaf Spot
diseases.description: Fungal disease causing angular brown lesions on leaves.
diseases.chemical_treatment: Apply appropriate fungicides if infection spreads.
diseases.prevention_tips: Practice crop rotation and use certified seed.
